1. (Currently Amended) A method for synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules, each module receiving a serial bit stream over a respective communications link, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, the method comprising the steps of: transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit, __wherein said trigger bit is transmitted at a data rate that is at least twice a data rate of said single clock source__, and triggering an event in a respective one of said modules upon receipt of a respective one of said at least one trigger bit.

2. (Currently Amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises __synchronous__ waveform digitization.

3. (Currently Amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises __synchronous__ waveform synthesis.

4. (Currently Amended) A method as recited in claim 1 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered, __wherein said receive packet is transmitted synchronously with said clock source__.

5. (Currently Amended) A method as recited in claim 4 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting synchronous results of said triggered measurement, __wherein said plurality of bits are transmitted at a data rate that is at least twice a data rate of said single clock source__.

12. (Currently Amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises __synchronous__ waveform digitization.
